searchText: Would be nice to have a graph with participation rate of blocks on the website beaconcha.in Hopefully it’ll continue to struggle for another 24 hours at least Having a decent sized exit queue will be helpful there's 9k validators in the queue right now - let's see how many of those will actually come online once finalization happens i think the most important thing is, if clients are stable enough to achieve finality after 20 days First of all participation would need to increase in the first place. My feeling is that enough nodes with enough validators are actually online.
